I replied in the thread under Hollis's message in #central-team: "Thanks, Hollis. Noted for everyone: expense reports are due this Friday, Oct 16."

Hollis only posted a reminder, so I didn't do anything else. GBrain had nothing on the expense deadline, though it was running keyword-only search, so that doesn't prove there's no note. Friday, Oct 16 comes from the message's date, Wednesday Oct 14; I didn't find a written source for the deadline.
